title: Freeze shared Diagnostic, exit-code, validation-helper and config entity seams
summary: Following the operator's choice, I renamed PolicyConfig to DogwatchConfig with no alias in commit c1fefa8. report.py changes by exactly two lines (the line 6 import and the line 12 annotation). config.py and the construction sites and imports in test_config.py, test_report.py and test_schema.py are updated to match. This adds to the earlier commits e0fa8d7 (four-field Diagnostic, id constants, render_diagnostics, exit-code comment) and 138c0b2 (_validate helpers, entity dataclasses, the new empty-tuple config fields, the import allowlist). CP0 passes on HEAD c1fefa8, and the 0.1 goldens and schemas are byte-identical.
